entities.name: PMID:27509907
observations: 2016 study of adolescent girls with anorexia nervosa (n=22), healthy controls (n=20), and psychiatric controls (n=117), reporting lower hair cortisol in AN than both control groups.
AN versus healthy controls: log hair cortisol was lower, p=0.030. The available abstract does not report the separate AN-versus-psychiatric-control p-value or group effect sizes.

entities.name: Lower HCC in AN
observations: In adolescent girls, the study states hair cortisol was lower in anorexia nervosa than in healthy and psychiatric controls; p=0.030 is reported for AN versus healthy controls, while a separate psychiatric-control comparison statistic is unavailable in the abstract.
